scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix mobile install && npm run ai:install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,mobile,ai -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix mobile run start -- --port 8082" "npm run ai:dev"
scripts.ai:install: python -m venv ai-service\.venv && .\ai-service\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .\ai-service\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r ai-service\requirements.txt
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix mobile run test
